backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing e-commerce functionality including access control, branding/homepage configuration, user profiles, product management, shopping cart, orders, Stripe integration, and inventory operations with admin/user role-based permissions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features: quick stock adjustment controls in ProductManagementTable, total inventory value calculator on Dashboard, and useTotalInventoryValue React Query hook.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files describing components, pages, hooks, and configuration for the e-commerce marketplace application with dynamic branding, product management, checkout flow, and admin dashboard.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining light and dark theme color palettes using OKLCH color space for backgrounds, foregrounds, borders, and component styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with title 'Original Creations Hub' and root div mounting the React application from main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes for marketplace, dashboard, checkout, payment, legal pages, and shopping basket, wrapped in ThemeProvider with Toaster and dynamic branding hook.
frontend/src/components/BrandingSettings: Admin component for configuring site branding including site name, logo, and favicon with file upload, preview, progress tracking, and form submission using React Query mutations.
frontend/src/components/BulkProductUploa: Component for bulk uploading multiple products with image files, allowing users to set name, description, shape, price, and inventory for each product. Includes AI-powered description generation and an auto-copy feature to sync fields from the first product to all others.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying site branding, legal links (Terms & Privacy Policy), contact email from shop details, and a 'Built with caffeine.ai' attribution link.
frontend/src/components/HomepageSettings: Admin settings component for customizing the homepage hero section, including hero motto text, promotional text, and hero image upload with preview functionality.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper providing site header with logo/branding, navigation (basket with item count badge, dashboard), authentication controls (login/logout), and footer. Uses Internet Identity for authentication.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Product card component displaying product image, name, shape, price, and an 'Add to Basket' button with loading state.
frontend/src/components/ProductDetailVie: Modal dialog showing detailed product view with large image, full description, price, and action buttons for 'Add to Basket' and 'Buy Now' (direct checkout).
frontend/src/components/ProductManagemen: Admin table component for managing products with inline editing of name/shape/price, image upload/replacement, and inventory increment/decrement controls.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Disabled profile setup modal component that returns null; previously used for post-login user profile configuration.
frontend/src/components/ShopDetailsSetti: Form component for configuring shop details including name, address, contact info, opening hours, and company tax details with validation and persistence.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetup.tsx: Setup form for configuring Stripe payment integration with secret key input and allowed countries configuration.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDynamicBranding.ts: Hook that dynamically updates document title and favicon based on branding configuration fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for all backend data operations including products, user profiles, cart, orders, Stripe configuration, branding, shop details, and analytics with mutations and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm terracotta and earthy color theme for both light and dark modes, plus Google Fonts imports for Crimson Pro and Inter.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page that displays cart items or a single "Buy Now" product, calculates totals, and creates a Stripe checkout session to redirect users to payment.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page with tabs for product management, bulk upload, Stripe setup, branding, shop details, and homepage settings, displaying inventory statistics and requiring admin authentication.
frontend/src/pages/Marketplace.tsx: Main marketplace/homepage displaying hero section with configurable background and motto, plus sections for featured, most viewed, best selling, and newest products with product detail modal.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Payment failure page displaying an error message with options to retry checkout or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Payment success confirmation page that clears the cart and buy-now session data, displaying a success message with option to continue shopping.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.tsx: Static privacy policy page displaying information collection practices, data usage, security measures, user rights, and contact information in a formatted card layout.
frontend/src/pages/ShoppingBasket.tsx: Shopping basket page component that displays cart items with quantity controls, removal functionality, and checkout navigation using React Query hooks and shadcn/ui components.
frontend/src/pages/Terms.tsx: Static terms and conditions page displaying legal information about products, pricing, shipping, returns, and intellectual property using a Card component layout.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for parameter persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, typography settings with Inter and Crimson Pro fonts, custom shadows, animations, and container queries plugin.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking architectural decisions, known issues (image persistence, Buy Now redirect, shipping collection), and completed features for an artisan marketplace with Stripe integration and bulk product upload.
